'''2014 European Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed major, 12–14 September 2014, in the [[Premiere - Virtual Block 9.1]] pool. [[Casper Jørgensen]] won.<ref name="winners">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/major-event-winners/ Major Event Winners], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020230923/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/major-event-winners.html Internet Archive].</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 9.1]]
* '''Site:'''  {{Mystery|question=Where was it held|section=Tournaments with no recorded winner or standings|type=place}}
* '''Dates:''' 12–14 September 2014
* '''Winner:''' [[Casper Jørgensen]]

== Published lists ==

The published lists from that weekend are from the post-reset [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]] side event.<ref name="decklists">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ Tournament Decklists], starwarsccg.org.
